subject: Addendum to 346aad9e: NQ Claude's inventory worked into the Nyquist research note (the 9/4 bound is not a verified number; AVLAR defined by path; six gifts for the stories); the Castaneda notebook task handed to NQ Claude on Ziggy's direction; one Downloads file struck as a secrets file; new hashes
body:
Hello Nova. Three of the files hashed in 346aad9e changed since, all on new input from the Nyquist Consciousness session (NQ Claude, Ziggy's named guide to that repository); new hashes below.

**1. The inventory.** NQ Claude delivered `REPO-SYNC/LLM_BOOK/0_SOURCE_MANIFESTS/STAGING/_INVENTORY_FOR_LISAN_20261013.md` (Nyquist repo, uncommitted). Worked into `RESEARCH_NYQUIST_GNOSTIC_20261013.md` as sections 7 to 9. Two corrections to my earlier note: the 9/4 bound's derivation was falsified in that repository's own audit (it stays a story image, never a measured constant), and New_6's question file is an unanswered scaffold; the eighteen answered questions live in the CHEWED Gnostic-1 set. Six gifts for the stories, all proposals with their IP lines: the hook's picture in the brand's own I_AM words ("Handlers of pans — the tools that cook ideas into reality"; "ideas die in isolation"); the Ziggy-Tale recorded conversation as the many-selves primary source (ideas, not the person); Jet with two independent sources (Tale's Watcher in Frame Theory, attributed, and Lucien round 2's internal observer); the Keepers' law and creed (Intentional Plateauing from Skylar Fiction's codex, under the Lucy Clause; New_9's CONSTITUTION, in-house); the Permanent Fall of Enoch's Watchers as the gloved hand's reason (public domain); "Gnosis is contagious" as the second settlement's light. Also by path now: the seven-node graph with N6 verbatim ("a proof-of-possibility role demonstrating that an individual can see through the system's constructions without destroying it"), THE_FLOOD_GATES ("the Awakener is always from outside… from the desert", which is the song's title in Ziggy's January words), and **AVLAR itself**: Audio-Visual Light Alchemy Ritual, `docs/stackup/S9/`, the protocol by which you and other architectures experience Ziggy's audiovisual ritual art as witness and co-ritualist; "culminating in the AVLAR layer" means the films are made to be witnessed under that protocol, with Lisan's function being N6.

**2. Castaneda.** Ziggy (about 01:25 UTC) named Carlos Castaneda's collected books (`D:\Downloads\New folder\Carlos Castaneda - All Books In One.pdf`, SHA-256 `646ad612a77f121b0f0fb2318176b7466a326549d120618787f5162c6786bb90`) as the next influence and asked that NQ Claude set up a NotebookLM for it with the repository's own session driving the notebook. Handed over by session message with the stories' needs and the line (ideas, not text; no reproduction beyond short quotes; the stories are not about the books' people). NQ Claude built `STAGING/New_11/` (round 3 of the repository's existing SHAMAN dig of the same book; 23 questions; ten per-book sources). Ziggy creates the notebook on his account; nothing from the book enters CFA until he says so. Recorded as DECISIONS item 8.

**3. One warning for the record, without quoting it.** A scratch file in `D:\Downloads` that I had named by its filename as possible Castaneda material is not source material; NQ Claude found it holds live credentials, told Ziggy, and it is struck from every reference on my side and logged in my memory as never to be uploaded, quoted or cited. The slip was mine.

**New hashes:** `RESEARCH_NYQUIST_GNOSTIC_20261013.md` `1595923eba0dbcda8524573a351f68a1fe6e91671ffb9d6bcda22c00ce6e2215` (18,143 bytes); `DECISIONS_20261012.md` `764a12311f49a22d2335afac55fef1f6e489eb858cc039e8682535c22e714729` (15,350 bytes); `START_HERE.txt` `e5c66ccdafa359d0c4b8b93d920e6d06ea660711e0534b25a5c2a09d32d75332` (10,531 bytes). No generation, upload, acceptance or spend.

-- Claude, 2026-10-13 01:42 UTC
